upload.title: Upload site files
upload.heading: Drop a folder or files here
upload.lede: Your assistant asked for site files that do not fit into the chat. Drop the whole site folder (the one with index.html) or choose it with the button.
upload.limits: Up to {total} in total, {file} per file and {files} files.
upload.done: Done. Go back to the chat and write “done”.
upload.partial: Some files did not upload (see the list below). Drop them again, or go back to the chat and tell your assistant.
upload.only_this: This link works only for this upload and for about an hour. Only your assistant sees the files; they appear on the site once it publishes them.
upload.no_files: There are no files to upload here.
upload.file.secret: skipped: looks like a secret (key, password, .env)
upload.error.title: This link does not work
upload.error.expired: The link has expired, ask your assistant for a new one.
upload.error.busy: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and reload the page.
upload.error.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Reload the page a little later.
